notes: Refs with ref_verified=true were resolved through official repository API. Acquired full source archives record actual SHA256/size/URL; null hashes remain unresolved.
Git commit/blob SHA1 is not an archive SHA256.
Default with Lime remains specified, but Lime runtime backend and hardware release remain disabled pending listed audits.
Null hashes or unresolved pins prevent offline/release verification; never substitute current/latest.

git_tree_sha1 (with git_submodules gitlinks) is the commit's git tree as the GitHub API reports it; fetch_sources.py tree recomputes it from the archive bytes, so a re-compressed GitHub archive can be re-reviewed by content.

apt_snapshot pins Ubuntu packages by a fixed snapshot.ubuntu.com timestamp: debian_source and binary_debs come only from gpgv-verified InRelease -> signed index -> Checksums-Sha256/SHA256 (fetch_sources.py resolve-debian / verify-debian).

apt_snapshot.method: deployment/fetch_sources.py resolve-debian: gpgv of each suite InRelease against the keyring and the pinned fingerprint, the signed SHA256 list for Sources.xz/Packages.xz, then Checksums-Sha256 of the exact source version and SHA256 of every arm64/all binary built from it. The same timestamp is the lab builder chroot snapshot (.github/workflows/sr-rx-packages.yml).
